verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Metorial generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside its own product. The dashboard features for reviewing traces, sessions and agent activity are manual inspection tools. The AI-analysis examples (the standup bot and code review bot) are sample apps developers build with the SDK, which makes them developer building blocks rather than an in-product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
